orders.text:
WPSS No. 1286 of 2017
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. M.S.Bhandari, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
Mr. H.M.Raturi, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State/respondents. 
Heard. 
Let counter affidavit be filed by the 
respondents within a period of four 
weeks. 
List thereafter. 
In the meantime, respondents are 
directed to pay at least minimum pay 
scale against the post of Junior 
Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator to 
the petitioner. 
Interim Relief Application No. 6041 
of 2017 stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari,J.)
 09.06.2017 
Nahid
